meta.title: Ondra Capability Sandbox
meta.description: Capability sandbox for Ondra (L9 extension pool, thin tier): it splits 'how much may this plugin do this time' into four levels (read / suggest / act / spend) and issues a ticket with an expiry and a use limit; anything beyond the ticket is refused. Four rulings are hard-wired: default-deny, where no ticket means no capability at all; a ticket dies at its expiry, and after that it must still be possible to say which ticket expired and at exactly which second (the record holds the deadline, not the moment someone noticed); the spend level requires a second confirmation, where the caller must put the action name verbatim into the confirm field, because a boolean always gets copied as true while retyping the action name at least requires knowing what is being done; the ticket file is written atomically with 0600 and holds tickets only — never arguments, return values, or reasons, because that would be a behaviour log. Boundary with the organ gate: that one decides whether an organ may use the host facade (an in-process capability allowlist), this one decides whether one concrete action should be allowed through (with a ticket, a deadline, and a use count); both layers must pass and neither replaces the other, and the two error classes are deliberately not identically named so a single catch cannot blur 'not entitled' into 'ticket expired'. It does not take over the host permission system, does not implement the organ ABI, renders no UI, installs no timers, and never sends anything on its own.
